Jio.summit.1: @... thank you. I have learned so much from you. How to be a better person. How to be a better partner.#$b#And I have loved the process of bettering myself almost as much as I love you.
Jio.summit.2: But I still have much to learn. I'll keep learning until the day I perish.#$b#Until then, please continue to take care of me, partner.$4
Festivals.EggFest.Jio_spouse: This is good training in tracking and observation for the young ones, though you are far too experienced to find it much more than a game, my partner.$1#$b#Still, should you wish to participate, I would be happy to offer reconnaissance.
Festivals.FlowerDance.Jio_spouse: I have studied the steps of this dance to perfection. I am confident I will be able to perform, should you be desiring of a dance.
Festivals.Luau.Jio_spouse: Kiwi is helping me remove anything deadly from the soup, but...$2#$b#Well, should we fall, we shall embrace death together.
Festivals.Jellies.Jio_spouse: Bliss is keeping an eye on the flow of magic in this area tonight. I wished to experience this as you do.#$b#What is your favorite part of this, partner?$1
Festivals.StardewFair.Jio_spouse: I understand that the competitions here are supposed to be fair, so I've left your competitor's stands alone.#$b#Still, since they are supposed to be fair, I suppose there will be no complaints if I counteract some of the tricks some of these 'games' are using, correct?$1
Festivals.SpiritEve.Jio_spouse: Forgive me, partner, but I shall be working tonight. There are too many dangerous things in the shadows who would use this time to their advantage.$2
Festivals.IceFest.Jio_spouse: Shall I slip underwater and drive the fish to your hook, partner?#$b#Fear not. I would do so with protection from the cold. It would be fun to do a joint mission, would it not?$1
Festivals.WinterStar.Jio_spouse: I... never understood this festival of gratitude, until I met you. Noticing an absence of something is much more difficult than noting its presence.$1
Festivals.Gathering.Jio_spouse: A curious competition is happening in the marketplace. Do you plan to join in?#$b#No? That does seem like it is the winning strategy, partner.$1
Festivals.EoR.Jio_spouse: The mountain god sends her regards, partner.$1#$b#Make sure you focus your ki when you add your part, so your energies can be properly renewed.
Romance.Engagement.Jio: You wish to formalize our bond, then?$6#$b#I... will accept.$4#$b#Please leave everything to me, I will enlist suitable help to ensure this goes properly.
Romance.give.flowersA.Jio: You...wish to form a relationship? But I have... little experience in such things...$2#$b#...$2#$b#No, that is not a valid response. Very well. If you... truly wish to bond with one such as I, I shall give you an honest attempt.
Romance.stardrop.gift.Jio: @... I have long considered what a suitable form of my expression to you would be.#$b#This Stardrop... after it touches your lips, it shall become one with your flesh, and its power shall aid you forevermore.#$b#So, too, do I wish to do with you.$4
Romance.rejectNPCA.Jio: @, I am far too busy to pursue romantic desires. Do you not also have things you wish to accomplish?
Romance.MovieInvite.Spouse.Jio: I would be happy to accompany you on this mission, partner.$1#$b#I wish to see what things you desire to see.
Jio.Dialogue.SpouseFarmhouseClutter: Come, @. You cannot simply leave things scattered in such a manner. You are cutting off any avenues of escape.$5
Jio.Dialogue.Spouse_MonstersInHouse: Stand back, @! I will dispose of this at once!
Jio.Dialogue.FlowerDance_Accept: Of course, my partner. I'll match your every move.$1
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.1: This is... unlike other missions I have undertaken, so please bear with my inexperience.
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.2: I have informed the Seer of our tentative alliance.#$b#I will spare you the indignity of her response.$5
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.3: I have procured a number of books regarding romance and relationships from the nearby town's library. I shall study them extensively.#$b#What is 'checking out'? Is that some local vernacular?
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.4: Would it be acceptable if I were to refer to you as my 'partner'? Romantic relationships are still relationships which are built on mutual respect and a shared mission, are they not?
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.5: Pay Daia no mind. I am unsure if she is excessively curious, or jealous, but either way I do not have reason to think she shall cause harm.#$B#You haven't seen her? Ah... forget I said anything.
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.6: Corine has offered to give me advice, should I desire. Yet she has little experience herself.#$b#Is her civilian upbringing that much of an advantage?
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.7: I wish to learn more about you, @... But we are so different, I am unsure where to begin.$2
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.8: Daia keeps offering me advice unprompted. I'm not sure I trust it.$5#$b#Even if I did... I do not think I am ready for some of her suggestions.$2
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.9: Does interacting with others come naturally to you?#$b#I never did undercover missions among society, so my knowledge of how to blend in is... limited.
Jio.Dialogue.8heart.10: I thought I would introduce myself to one of your civilian friends, in order to get to know them.#$b#...Please apologize for my scaring them on my behalf.
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.1: A lovely day to you, my fairest beloved.$1#$b#...Why do all these poems use 'fairest'? You are far more than a mere 'fair', my partner.
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.2: Corine says I should ask you about how your day is going.#$b#But I am already informed of your major movements and tasks, either through direct observation or Kiwi and Daia's reports. Can you explain the purpose of such conversation?
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.3: Being with you... is changing me, partner.$1#$b#Fear not. Like a sharpened blade, I am still myself, only better.$1
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.4: I never paid much attention to your ki since Corine and Helen outstrip you in power, but... now that I focus on it, it gives you such a comfortable aura.#$b#I suppose strength isn't everything.$1
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.5: I believe this is the first time I have actively desired to speak so much with another. You are truly special, partner.$1
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.6: I spoke with the local psychologist for advice regarding relationships.#$b#I... failed to grasp a number of the terms she used. It seems I still lack training.$2
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.7: Do you... think about the future much, @?#$b#I have always focused on the present mission alone, but... now I find myself wondering what our partnership will look like as it continues to develop.$4
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.8: As much as I enjoy our time together, I cannot fully let down my guard.$2#$b#Still, I have made some enemies in my work, so that may be for the best.
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.9: I wish to learn as much as I can about your way of life.#$b#Aside from my curiosity about you, I do not wish to be a partner who will burden you with my ignorance.
Jio.Dialogue.10heart.10: I still expect that my fate will always be tied to combat, but... Perhaps with you, there can be something aside from that.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_1: The lines of power have revived. It's good for growth, but have a little caution that this fresh influx does not overwhelm you, partner.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_12: Kiwi is very fond of the festival tomorrow.#$b#I think the shape of the eggs remind her of her own shape.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spring_23: %Jio is muttering to himself.#$b#Step, crouch, step, crouch, then a step forward....
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_1: You have a lot to do today. Speak if you need assistance, but otherwise I shall seek to not be an obstacle.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_10: Do you need anything for our contribution to the meal tomorrow? I am happy to bring you something while I am out on reconnaissance.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.summer_27: The Lunaloos have a presence that makes even monsters hesitate to interfere with their path. There should be no issues on the morrow.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_1: The zenith of light energies has passed. Troublesome things may try and take advantage before the world falls to slumber. Stay on your toes, partner.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_15: I'll be on patrol tomorrow, watching for trouble. The fair will happen without incident.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.fall_26: You might think it strange to go outdoors on such a dangerous night tomorrow, but such rituals are actually rather effective at pushing away certain dark forces.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_1: All the great powers may be at rest, but that doesn't mean that we should, partner. Now is the time to prepare for the upcoming year.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_7: I still find myself unsure why ice is to be celebrated with such a festival. Perhaps it will make sense once I learn more about civilian life.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_17: Shall we investigate the Night Market tonight, partner? This market overlaps with the world of the unseen, so there may be useful relics to find there.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.winter_24: I look forward to the feast tomorrow. Despite the cold, it has a warmth about it.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.1: %Jio is studying a map of the Ridgeside area. He looks deep in thought.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.2: One's tools must always be kept sharp, so they can be relied on.#$b#Would you like me to examine the edges of your blades, partner?$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.3: Should you be curious, I would be happy to show you the contents of my drawers with supervision, since they can be dangerous.#$b#Hm? Is something amusing?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.4: Maintenance and organization of one's resources is part of the job, as well. My apologies, but I must devote some time to this.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.5: %Jio is inspecting the edge of a throwing knife. Seems he's not quite satisfied with it yet.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.6: Kiwi asked me to sharpen her knives, so I need to finish this promptly. We wouldn't want her to be without.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.7: Are you familiar with the other towns in this area? I'm trying to get more knowledgeable about the surrounding territory.#$b#Do you know of Sunberry? That innkeeper seems dangerous.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.8: Are you familiar with the other towns in this area? I'm trying to get more knowledgeable about the surrounding territory.#$b#Have you visited the Vapius area? They seem to be surprisingly well-defended, given the monsters in that area.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.9: %Jio is making notes. He pauses as he sees you.#$b#...My apologies, but I can't share this with you. There are certain secrets I must keep for your own safety.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.spouseRoom_Jio.10: %Jio is checking each of his tools in detail. Does he carry all of this?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.1: Would you like to practice a bout, partner?$10#$b#Do be warned that I won't go easy on you, since monsters won't.$11
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.2: Just as you cannot lay fallow for even a day, lest your crops wilt, so too must I diligently train.$10
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.3: Daia said I should train more with my shirt off, but truthfully, I would probably be more comfortable with my shirt on.$10#$b#But my skin is for only you to see.$13
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.4: %Jio is so focused, he doesn't seem to notice your presence. Probably best not to bother him.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.5: Will you be working on the fields today?#$b#I do enjoy seeing you in the corners of my eyes while I train.$11
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.6: You are welcome to join me in meditation. Improving your senses can only make you safer on your trips into dangerous areas.$12
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.7: Some of my coworkers think I might go 'soft' because I am now wed.$10#$b#It's because I am wed that I will not. I WILL protect my family.$10
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.8: I am learning to attune my senses to the sounds and smells of the farm, so that I may better know what is amiss.$10
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.9: Hm? I look hot?$10#$b#Fear not, I am taking proper precautions for the weather.$10
Jio.MarriageDialogue.patio_Jio.10: %Jio is speaking quietly to himself as he meditates, but you can't make out the words.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_10: Rainy days are good for covert missions. But I was told there was nothing that needs my attention today.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_1: It's pretty common to stay indoors during rain for ordinary people, but I am unused to it.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_2: Are you leaving the house for work today? I trust you will take protective measures.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_3: Daia told me I should stay home and keep you warm, but I don't think she considered that you might leave the house for work.$2#$b#I shall be here to warm you up when you return, however.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_4: Ah, I left one of the windows open to get a little fresh air inside. I suppose it's now fresher than I intended.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_5: Be wary if you venture outside. Rain will drown out the sounds of danger nearby.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_6: I think I shall spend some time reading today.#$b#I am rather enjoying some of the poetry I've been borrowing, even if I don't feel I am learning from it.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_7: Part of me is glad that I do not have to venture out today.$2#$b#I used to think it was a sign of weakness, but... I don't think there is any benefit to being wet and in discomfort when not needed.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_8: Are you sure you don't wish to stay home today?#$b#I know you well enough to know you rarely come to a stop, but perhaps there are indoor tasks you can focus on?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Day_9: Be careful if you wish to venture to the Ridge, partner. There are some things that only emerge in the rain.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_10: The sound of the rain muffles everything from outside.#$b#It's almost as if nothing in this world exists except this house, and us.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_1: Do you ever feel as if the rain is whispering messages to you?#$b#It sounds to me as if it is saying I should hold you in my arms.#$b#It wouldn't do to defy nature, would it?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_2: Tonight, I wish to focus on nothing but you. Would you oblige me?$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_3: Ah, are you wet? Here, let me come and help you with that.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_4: I feel as if I was waiting an eternity for you to return home, tonight.#$b#Though, since I waited my whole life to be able to meet you, I suppose in a way I was.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_5: The gray and drabness of the rain outside makes your form look all the more beautiful.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_6: There is naught that needs tending to on such a quiet night. Shall we attend to each other?$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_7: I find it so easy to tell you that I love you when we are alone in our house like this.#$b#I don't think it's embarrassment, just that I wish for my feelings to be known only to you.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_8: You did well today, working in such conditions. Shall I give you a reward?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Rainy_Night_9: Some things like to take advantage of the rain, but I made sure none caused harm to your land.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_10: Belinda said I should take more days off. In truth, not having a mission in front of me makes me feel anxious.$2#$b#I suppose I shall find some missions around the house that need completing instead.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_1: Do you feel as if I spend enough time home? Since I have been alone for so long, I am unsure of how much togetherness is desired.#$b#Say the word, and I shall give you all you wish.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_2: If you are leaving the home today, I shall stay to guard the premises.#$b#Rest assured, none shall cause issue on your lands.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_3: Could I trouble you to bring some cleaning supplies home from Pierre's if you are in the area?#$b#No, I am not AFRAID of him, he is simply irritating.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_4: My mission today involves combat. My weapon is a broom, and the enemy, the dirt on the floors. I swear this one will be completed successfully.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_5: Perhaps today I shall practice my cooking skills.#$b#I'm not sure if it will be satisfying, but at least it should be edible.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_6: Do you plan to visit the mines or the Ridge today?#$b#It concerns me, but I suppose you share the same fear whenever I leave for a mission.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_7: I think I shall do some studying today and learn more about your culture and way of living.#$b#Every piece I learn and understand, I feel as if it completes me a bit more.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_8: I shall guard the farmhouse today. You have nothing to fear within your territory, so if you need to run errands, feel free.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Day_9: What do you plan to do today, partner? I shall be at hand, should you need anything.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_10: I have not had much experience in household tasks before now, but I believe I have adapted deftly to them.#$b#I stand ready to accept your critiques, should you wish to inspect my work.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_1: Maintaining a house is far different from my usual line of work.#$b#The act of protecting and supporting something important... It feels as an expression of my love for you.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_2: I've prepared some plum pudding. Perhaps you'd like to share it with me?$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_3: Are your muscles sore from work?#$b#Come, let me show you some effective remedies. It wouldn't do to injure them.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_4: Partner, would you like to be intimate tonight?$4#$b#I only wish for it if you are as enthusiastic about it as I am.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_5: A person may need many things to live, but right now the only thing I need is you. Do you feel the same, partner?$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_6: May I... share some stories about myself with you, tonight?$4#$b#I wish to share all of myself with you, just as I wish to know all of you.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_7: Welcome home, partner.#$b#It brings me such joy to be able to say that.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_8: What do you wish to do tonight, partner? Shall we share some skinship, or perhaps something more intensive?$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Indoor_Night_9: Are you weary? Let me focus all my attention on you, so that all your needs and wants are met.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_10: %Jio is scanning the perimeter for trouble.#$b#No issues to report.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_1: One cannot truly appreciate the beauty of a farm until one has seen all the diligent work that goes into each plot of land.$h#$b#It's similar to combat training. True mastery is built on hours and hours of unflagging training.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_2: You are my partner, but seeing your skill over your domain reminds me that you are the master and I am your servant in regards to the land.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_3: The flow of energies through this land is excellent. You were blessed with quite the place to live.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_4: Being in direct sunlight feels strange. I am more used to the shadows.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_5: It's interesting to observe the way your animals of the farm move, in contrast to wild animals.#$b#Yours have no fear or anxiety in their body language.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_6: I wonder if you would be interested in raising some plants and herbs to sell to the Cult?#$b#Nothing poisonous, I mean! The type to aid healing!$6
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_7: My apologies if I was not present when you awoke. I desired a little time to myself.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_8: @, did you know flowers have their own code with which you can send messages through a bouquet?#$b#I found a book on it in the library. Shall I see what your farm is saying?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Outdoor_9: If you see Kiwi wandering about, please feel free to send her my way. She keeps me informed.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.1: I'll be out on a mission today.#$b#I should be back by nightfall, but should something delay me, I'll send word so you won't need to worry.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.2: Knowing that my tasks today will contribute to the well-being of you and those around you gives me a little extra motivation to do well today.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.3: Should you need anything at all, you can send word through Daia.#$b#Even if you only need an errand on the way home, do not hesitate.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.4: There is much to be done in the world to preserve its safety and happiness, partner.#$b#I will endeavor to restrain my longing for you until you return, so please endure it as well.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.5: I know you are a most capable individual and I have nothing to fear during my absence, but all the same, I wish you to take care.#$b#Please do not believe that I think less of you because of my irrational worries.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.6: I hear it is a custom for a spouse to give a blessing to one's blade before entering combat.#$b#Would you do me the honor?$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.7: Today, I must attend to my duties. And you have your tasks here, on the land. Let us both be successful, today.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.8: Some days, I wish you could accompany me on my tasks.$2#$b#But even if Belinda would allow it, you have your own missions. I would not wish to distract you.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.9: Be careful if you head out today, partner. There are undesired malevolences in the valley.#$b#I will be taking care of them, so they won't be here for long.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funLeave_Jio.10: I'll be on the Ridge today. Exercise caution if you should need to go there.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.1: I have returned from today's mission. There were no injuries.#$b#I trust your work was just as fruitful?$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.2: I'm not able to share the details, but rest assured our task was completed without issue.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.3: Today, I am ashamed to report I sustained some minor injuries, though nothing of a level that will impede me.$2#$b#Daia said I should have you 'kiss it and mak it better', but of course I would not make such a request if it were to make you uncomfortable.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.4: I am embarrassed to admit to you that I made an error in today's mission because I was thinking of you instead of focusing.$2#$b#Please, chastise me properly.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.5: I have returned without incident. Those of the Cult all send their regards.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.6: Forgive me if I am not too close tonight. I sustained a couple of injuries today, and while they are not serious, I should probably refrain from contact until they finish healing.$2.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.7: I was successful in my mission today, and I even had spare time to pick up the vinegar you requested. Here you are.$1 [419]
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.8: I had time to stop by the village on my way back, so I brought you dinner. I hope you like it! [Rafseazz.RSVCP_Fried_Fish_a_la_Ridge Rafseazz.RSVCP_Fried_Mountain_Greens Rafseazz.RSVCP_Ginger_Arugula_Fried_Rice Rafseazz.RSVCP_Honey_Ginger_Whitefish]
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.9: Kiwi says hello.#$b#Well, actually, she said 'If you hurt Jio, Kiwi stab', which is about as close as she gets.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.funReturn_Jio.10: Things should be ever so slightly safer for you after today.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_10: To think that something so small and defenseless would be entrusted to my care... I still cannot fully comprehend it.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_1: I am surprised so many have children. It does not seem well-suited for the squeamish.#$b#I can handle the cleanup without issue, fear not.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_2: Children... are so fragile, aren't they? I fear that if I take my eyes off them, they'll disappear.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_3: Corine warned me that I should put locks on my weapons drawers and racks. But surely a child cannot reach such things so easily?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_4: Grrr.. %kid1! You are more slippery and tenacious than Kiwi!
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_5: Even at such an undeveloped age, %kid1 still shows such personality. Are we all so distinct when young?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_6: How do you decipher what %kid1 wants when they are crying? If only they could use language!$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_7: How long before we can start some light training, do you think?#$b#Years?? Do they really grow that slowly?$6
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_8: What should we do if we both need to work away from the farm at the same time?#$b#'Babysitter'? I take it this is some kind of idiom and they don't literally sit on the child?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.OneKid_9: Logically, I understand that %kid1 does not understand language to know what it means when I tell them I love them.#$b#But I shall say it all the same.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_10: Keeping an eye on both children at once is proving to be a surprising challenge.#$b#Do you suppose they are learning from watching myself and Kiwi?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_1: It still leaves me in awe that we are the guardians of such small lives.#$b#It's such a small mission in the scope of the world, and yet, for them, it is the world.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_2: Taking care of the children occasionally reminds me of when Kiwi first came under my authority.#$b#They have her same sense of innocent mischief.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_3: I have received a new set of locks from Bliss for my tool drawers. Let us see children best THESE.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_4: I think %kid2 is learning some bad habits from %kid1. Particularly about getting into places they shouldn't.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_5: Do you suppose our children will be close as they grow up?#$b#Growing up in the company of a sibling is a completely foreign experience to me. I am curious about it.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_6: Corralling two children is proving to be difficult at times.$2#$b#If I didn't know any better, I'd think they were planning their escapes.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_7: Every time I think I have learned sufficiently of family life, I am again proven wrong.#$b#Would you like to guess what I discovered our children can do today?
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_8: I had almost forgotten from our first child how short sleep is.$2#$b#My training will see me through this, do not worry.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.TwoKids_9: It won't be safe to take them outside our domain until they are older. But when they can, I wish to show them much of the world.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_0: The smell and the energies of the earth are strong on you today.#$b#When I hold you close, it envelops me in your comfort.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_1: There is so much in the world that reminds me of you.$h#$b#The wind is the sound of your hair and clothes, the sunlight is your eyes.$h#$b#I still do not understand poetry, so I hope this will do.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_2: Your ki is overflowing today, @. It's incredible.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_3: How is it that in my eyes, you are beautiful no matter what you do?$4#$b#Every smudge of dirt, every misplaced lock of hair only adds to your charm.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_4: My missions in the Cult may give me purpose, but you, @, give me a home.$4#$b#You made me realize there is more to living than merely existing for a purpose.$1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_5: If you're traveling today, take this with you. One should always be prepared. [771] $1
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_6: Ah, is that a cut on your arm?#$B#I have some effective medicine from the Cult, let me treat it. Even a minor cut can become dangerous.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_7: Sometimes, I just wish to hold you, and feel your skin on mine.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_8: Is there something I can help you with today? Your joy is my joy.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Good_9: I love you, @.$4#$b#I just want to remind you of that.$h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_0: Someone was prowling around in the early hours. I accosted them, but it seems it was only the mail carrier..#$b#...I shall leave them an apology note in the mailbox tonight.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_1: @, I have discovered a meal suited to the skills with knives I already have. Would you care to try it? [227] $h
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_2: Is this 'Lewis' really trustworthy? Skulking about in the early morning is only for those of the blade, not civilians like him.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_3: I apologize if I am still getting used to some of the technology in your home.#$b#I'll try not to destroy any more of them.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_4: I'm familiar with that fortune teller on television. She drinks too much, but her predictions are generally accurate.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_5: The civilians are all quite friendly with you, @.#$b#I hope my lack of interpersonal knowledge does not damage your reputation with them.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_6: %Jio yawns.#$b#Ah, my apologies. There were things trespassing that needed to be dealt with at an awkward time last night.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_7: Will you...show me your scars sometime?$4#$b#I wish to know about each of your victories over death.$4
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_8: Today, I am going to try a new civilian food, in the hopes that I can understand its popularity. Would you like to share the experience with me? [206 211 213 223 224 233 253 346 395 648]
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Neutral_9: Most humans are detached from the world of nature and magic and otherworldly things. But perhaps that is better for their survival.
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_0: We come from different worlds, @... Maybe we should have stayed in them.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_1: I don't understand you, @. You've changed.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_2: If you are this bored with me, just let me go. Let's not drag this out further.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_3: Did I err in choosing to trust you?$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_4: We've spent so much time together and come so far, and now you've decided it's not worth continuing? Is a commitment so easy to give up?$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_7: %Jio seems on high alert, like he is expecting trouble.#$b#Don't disturb me.$5
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_8: The walls of this house are suffocating.$2
Jio.MarriageDialogue.Bad_9: Do I even have a purpose here?$2

MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.2: It seems Jio is studying poetry. Let's see... #I long to talk with some old lover's ghost,^Who died before the god of love was born^I cannot think that he, who then lov'd most^Sunk so low as to love one which did scorn#It's not too bad, but you don't think it's going to teach him much about love.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.3: It looks like some notes on one of Jio's missions.#You quickly set it back down.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.4: It's a rather racy romance novel.#You suspect Jio may have 'borrowed' this from Lenny.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.5: It looks like a self-help book on communicating with others.
MapString.SpouseRoom.Jio.6: A psychological book on emotions.#It's highly scientific and you're not sure you understand even half of it.
